visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a dark blue long-sleeved shirt is seated behind a multi-piece silver and black drum set on a large, elevated stage. To his left stands a man in a grey plaid blazer and glasses, interacting with the boy. The stage is illuminated by bright purple and blue spotlights from above, while the background reveals a vast, dimly lit audience area with thousands of purple glowing light sticks. (2) A male singer in a white short-sleeved shirt approaches the drum set and initiates a count-in with his hands. The boy begins to play a rhythmic beat on the drums. The camera cuts between medium shots of the boy’s focused expression and wider shots of the stage interaction. White and yellow text overlays appear periodically in the middle and bottom of the frame. (3) The boy performs an energetic drum sequence in synchronization with the band's performance. The lighting transitions into rapid blue and white strobes. Brief cutaway shots show a female audience member smiling and clapping enthusiastically while wearing a black sweater and glasses. The boy continues to hit the cymbals and snare with high intensity until the end of the clip.
